name: emw-missalignment
label: MissAlignment
help:
Wrapper to run miss-alignment for tilt-series alignment improvement. 

*REFERENCES*:
[[https://github.com/warpem/miss-alignment/tree/main][miss-alignment]]

params.name: ts_aretomo.angpix
params.label: Output pixel size (A/pix)
params.help: Rescale tilt images to this pixel size; normally 10–15 A for cryo data; leave out to keep the original pixel size.

params.name: ts_aretomo.alignz
params.label: Align Z (A)
params.help: REQUIRED Value for AreTomo's AlignZ parameter in Angstroms (will be auto-converted to binned pixels), i.e. the thickness of the reconstructed tomogram used for alignments.

params.name: ts_aretomo.patches
params.label: Patches
params.help: Number of patches for local alignments in X, Y, separated by 'x': e.g. 6x4. By default (empty, or 0x0 or 1x1) only global alignment is performed. More patches increase the processing time.

params.name: gpus
params.label: GPUs
params.help: If it is a single number (N), it will represent the total number of GPUs (0..N-1). It there are multiple values, it will be the specific GPUs ID.

params.label: Launchers
params.help: Launchers to use for the different programs
